units.function: Pure tests for product-home expansion, instance ID/default and per-instance config-path layout.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls home/path helpers and environment variables only; no config or filesystem authorization runs beyond one temporary directory.
units.lifecycle: Resolves default/explicit home and instance values, expands tilde and rejects a slash-containing instance ID.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. Basic nesting and one invalid-ID case work; canonical roots, cross-platform separators/reserved names/collisions, symlinks/mounts, permissions and full path lifecycle are untested.
units.designRationale: Give each local instance an isolated configuration namespace under one product home.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS self-hosted and FDE deployments require stable, portable, collision-resistant data/config namespaces per customer and environment.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the per-instance namespace and strict ID resolver, expanding tests to opaque generated IDs, all platform separators/reserved names, Unicode/case collisions, canonical approved roots, symlink/mount/mode ownership and migration/backup boundaries.
units.responsibilityConflict: Filesystem namespace selection is not an authorization grant; access must still derive from human/Connector identity and data contracts.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 4 passed via existing local binary
